title: Rani Purnima Debi v. Kumar Khagendra Narayan Deb

content.caseIdentity: Rani Purnima Debi v. Kumar Khagendra Narayan Deb, AIR 1962 SC 567
content.facts: The Supreme Court considered a dispute requiring interpretation of the governing family-law provision or closely connected statutory rule.
questionsBeforeCourt: What is the correct legal interpretation and application of the governing statutory rule?
content.ratioDecidendi: The propounder of a will must establish due execution and the testator's free and sound testamentary act; suspicious circumstances require satisfactory explanation.
content.holding: The propounder of a will must establish due execution and the testator's free and sound testamentary act; suspicious circumstances require satisfactory explanation.
content.relevance: Use this authority for the stated statutory proposition, while matching the case facts and the current statutory text before relying on it.
